events.title: Boxes by the Door
events.text: {person:child} is moving out. The boxes have been packed with alarming efficiency.

choices.label: Help with the deposit
choices.outcome_text: A new key, a tight hug, and a very quiet drive home.

choices.label: Give furniture and fierce pride
choices.outcome_text: My lamp has a new life now.

choices.label: Are you sure about this?
choices.outcome_text: They left anyway, and the goodbye was colder than the weather.

events.title: The Wedding
events.text: {person:child} is getting married and, delicately, budget conversations have begun.

choices.label: Contribute properly
choices.outcome_text: The toast I gave made the whole tent cry.

choices.label: A modest gift, lovingly chosen
choices.outcome_text: It wasn't the biggest gift, and they knew what it meant.

choices.label: Offer time instead: plan it with them
choices.outcome_text: Six weeks of spreadsheets and one unforgettable day.

events.title: Between Jobs
events.text: {person:child} lost their job. The brave voice on the phone fooled no one.

choices.label: Cover their rent this month
choices.outcome_text: That's what family is for, I said, and meant it.

choices.label: Work the problem together over dinner
choices.outcome_text: Three hours, two pots of coffee, one plan.

choices.label: They're an adult now
choices.outcome_text: I told my adult child to handle the job loss alone, and our phone calls got shorter.

events.title: In-Law Troubles
events.text: {person:child} unloads about their partner over coffee. It is the third time this month.

choices.label: Side with your kid, obviously
choices.outcome_text: My loyalty was noted. So was the escalation.

choices.label: Stay diplomatically neutral
choices.outcome_text: I listened, nodded, and fixed nothing — which helped.

choices.label: Defend the partner
choices.outcome_text: I defended my child's partner over coffee, and the chat ended early and cold.

events.title: Your Birthday
events.text: {person:child} wants to take you out for your birthday. They are insistent.

choices.label: Let them treat you
choices.outcome_text: Watching them signal the waiter was worth every year.

choices.label: Insist on cooking for everyone instead
choices.outcome_text: My kitchen, my rules, my favourite people.

choices.label: Keep it low-key this year
choices.outcome_text: A phone call, a card, quiet contentment.

events.title: Breakdown on the Highway
events.text: {person:child}'s car died dramatically on the highway, one week before rent is due.

choices.label: Pay for the repairs
choices.outcome_text: The car lives. The gratitude was loud.

choices.label: Lend part, they cover the rest
choices.outcome_text: A handwritten IOU appeared on my fridge.

choices.label: Teach them to budget around it
choices.outcome_text: I taught my kid to budget around the car repairs: useful, unpopular, and useful.
